:::{#def-weibull}
#### Weibull distribution

A non-negative random variable $T$ has the **Weibull distribution**
with shape $\shape > 0$ and rate $\rate > 0$
[@wikipedia_weibull_distribution]
if its
[survival function](random-variables.qmd#def-surv-fn) is:

$$\surv(t) \eqdef \text{e}^{-\rate t^\shape}, \quad t \ge 0$$

:::
